import json, os, sys
out, mode = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
with open(out, 'w') as handle:
    json.dump({'argv': sys.argv, 'env': list(os.environ.items()), 'bytecode_off': sys.flags.dont_write_bytecode}, handle)
if mode.startswith('exit:'):
    sys.exit(int(mode[5:]))
if mode.startswith('kill:'):
    os.kill(os.getpid(), int(mode[5:]))

#!/bin/bash
out=$1
printf '%s\n' "argv0=$0" "args=$*" "n=$#" "pdwb=$PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE" "x=$S2E_X" > "$out"
case $2 in exit:*) exit "${2#exit:}" ;; kill:*) kill -"${2#kill:}" $$ ;; esac
